title: Recognize What value\_counts Stores
text: fav\_flavors stores how many times each soda flavor appears. The index contains the flavor names, and the values contain the counts.

title: Parts of a value\_counts Series
text: In fav\_flavors, what do fav\_flavors.index and fav\_flavors.values represent?

title: Why countplot Works
text: sns.countplot(data=staff\_poll, $$x="flavor")$$ counts each category directly from the original staff\_poll data, recreating the same frequency information as fav\_flavors.

title: Eliminate Histograms and Boxplots
text: A histogram and a boxplot are mainly used for numerical distributions. Here, the goal is to compare counts for categorical soda flavors.

title: Why plt.bar Works
text: plt.bar(fav\_flavors.index, fav\_flavors.values) uses the flavor names as the x-axis categories and the counts as the bar heights, so it directly visualizes the value\_counts Series.
